source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Update: Modifying Existing Records as printed (PDF 60, printed 56); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the topic 4.2 lesson.

blocks.text: The Update operation changes existing data in a database. It is used when stored information needs correction. SQL update commands modify selected records. Python executes these commands based on conditions. Only the specified data is changed during this process.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Update a student's marks and display updated data.
